title: A target list for your own telescope
description: Objects from the catalog and coordinates of your own are gathered into a plan for supported equipment.

blocks.text: An experienced observer may need objects that are not in a ready-made atlas. In one review that request comes from photometry: the person wants to enter coordinates and aim the telescope. That is a narrower job than a general screen for preparing equipment.

quote.text: The telescope itself is fun to use. I am starting to use it to do photometry of variable stars and AGN. These objects usually aren’t in the app’s sky atlas. It would make life so much easier if I could input RA and Dec, then GoTo.

blocks.text: Let a target be added by name or by coordinates and saved into the plan. For the particular models that are supported, show whether slewing and the operating modes needed are available.
Compatibility has to be confirmed for particular models. A successful connection does not yet mean that every slewing and imaging mode is supported.
